## Packaging

- The addon ZIP now includes a local `.gitignore` that keeps bundled native libraries visible to Git despite common project rules such as `[Bb]in/` and `*.dll`. This fixes [#22](https://github.com/outfox/tweens.gd/issues/22).
- The standalone tutorial includes the same guard. Package smoke tests check that every bundled addon file remains visible to Git while build outputs outside the addon stay ignored.

## Downloads

The library API and runtime behavior are unchanged from 0.2.2-beta.

- **Godot addon:** `tweens.gd-0.2.3-beta.zip` includes C# and GDScript sources, stable UIDs, and prebuilt native libraries. Requires Godot 4.7 or later (tested with 4.7.2); C# additionally requires Godot .NET and .NET 8 or later. GDScript-only projects do not require .NET.
- **Standalone tutorial:** `tweens.gd-tutorial.zip` includes the complete tutorial project, export presets and the 0.2.3-beta addon. Requires Godot .NET 4.7.2 and the .NET 8 SDK or later.
- **Compiled C# package:** `tweens.gd.0.2.3-beta.nupkg`, targeting .NET 8 and .NET 10, with symbols in `tweens.gd.0.2.3-beta.snupkg`.

**Full changelog:** [v0.2.2-beta…v0.2.3-beta](https://github.com/outfox/tweens.gd/compare/v0.2.2-beta...v0.2.3-beta)
